messages:
maria: Heads-up — p99 TTFT for token-length buckets 1-8 in eu-west spiked ~2.5s at 08:12 UTC. Grafana heatmap shows a vertical band coinciding with last week's rollup aggregation change. :eyes:
akshay: saw that alert. looks like aggregation changed from high-res to 1m rollup? can you paste the panel query?
maria: here's the panel query I used:
```
sum by (shard) (
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))
)
```
also the panel legend shows `le` buckets from the kube histogram.
jordan: that promql looks okay. suspect the rollup rule `job:hist:rate5m` normalized `le` incorrectly in the aggregate. there was an infra PR last week that removed `le` relabel in the aggregator.
leo: I think the issue is re-bucketing during rollup — we accidentally compacted boundaries to coarse bins (1ms,10ms,100ms) which can blow up histogram_quantile for low-latency slices like 1-8 tokens.
maria: repro quick check: raw histogram -> p99 ~120ms, rollup-derived p99 -> 2.6s. raw vs rollup mismatch is huge.
akshay: quick mitigation — switch the dashboard to query raw histogram until rollup is fixed, and mute the noisy alert. add an annotation so others know it's expected.
maria: added grafana annotation "rollup-agg-change" on the panel and muted the alert for 1h. :thumbsup:
jordan: opened infra PR to preserve `le` during rollup and add `le`-aware merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432
leo: we should also backfill corrected rollup for last 24h to avoid alert thrash. I'll run the tsdb-rewrite in staging and bump to prod if green.
deploy-bot: deploy started for infra/metrics-rollup v1.2.3 by leo. ETA ~6m.
akshay: when deploy finishes, update the dashboard comparison panel (raw vs rollup) and re-enable alerts. also consider relaxing alert sensitivity for very small-token buckets (p95->p99 window or larger aggregation).
maria: acknowledged. I'll coordinate with oncall to watch for false positives and add runbook steps. runbook snippet I added:
```
1) Open panel -> Query -> compare `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))`
2) Toggle 'Use raw metrics' to confirm difference
3) If rollup > raw by > 300ms -> mute alert, annotate panel, and file infra issue
```
jordan: deploy-bot: deploy finished. status: success. :shipit:
maria: seeing p99 back to normal in eu-west after the fix. will keep the annotation for 24h then remove. thanks all. :tada:
leo: follow-up: filing a ticket to add unit tests for rollup rules to ensure `le` label is preserved and coverage for small-token buckets. will link PR to ticket.
